title: (A) Renovated home! Less than 4 miles to downtown!
description:
This 2bed/1bath duplex unit is a great space to stay while visiting Nashville. We are conveniently located South of Downtown (3.8 miles) in the neighborhood of Woodbine!

The space
This 2 bed/1 bath home has just went through a complete renovation! All New Windows, Hardwoods, Granite, Appliances, & Bluetooth Speaker in Bathroom! It is located in the heart of Woodbine, an up & coming neighborhood! The home is located 3.8 miles from Downtown ($10 Uber Ride) & 7.2 miles to the Airport ($15 Uber Ride)! This home is a duplex and the other side is also an Airbnb, so if you need additional space check out unit B too! The kitchen is fully equipped for guests to enjoy! 

The kitchen appliances include: Refrigerator, Oven, Microwave, Dishwasher, Coffee Maker, & Toaster!

Washer, Dryer, Iron/Ironing board, & HairDryer Available!

HD TV in Both Bedrooms!

Guest access
Guest will be given a unique code to enter in the home! 

Guest will have access to plenty of parking in the driveway (can accommodate 3 cars)!

Guest can enjoy the Firepit located in the backyard (firewood is not included)!

Laundry Closet is a shared space Available for Guests to use!

Other things to note
I love Nashville! Whether you are visiting for business or pleasure, my hope is that you love your visit to Nashville!

I strive to provide 5 star service for my Guests! For this reason if Guests have any reason they wouldn't leave a 5 star review, Please let me know so I can address it!
